result:
The integration suite finished and failed: 4118 tests passed and 1 failed (exit 1, about 66 minutes on a busy machine). So acceptance item 3 (integration passes) is not met on this tree.

The failing test is the one I flagged earlier: the "P5 BE-J operations" check in `apps/api/test/integration/contract/response-validation.test.ts`. At `p5-exercises-be-j.ts:61`, `listDependencySlips` returns no slip where one is expected. My changes are all under `apps/web/**`, so they can't have caused it. The test hard-codes milestone dates of 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-01, and today is 2026-10-31, so it may break depending on the current date. I haven't confirmed that; it needs the backend engineer who owns BE-J or the orchestrator.

I appended these results to the handback (`docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-FE-X3-frontend-ux-engineer.md`) as Addendum 2. The other open item is unchanged: the whole `apps/web/e2e` set still needs one clean run on the final tree. My changes remain uncommitted.
